original_split_out1.format: query1 , query2 , label(-1/1)  [DIFFERENT SCHEMA than newMedium.txt]
original_split_out1.leakage_finding: Original train/test split is a contiguous 80/20 line-order split of a single file, NOT query-grouped. Any query1 value appearing in more than one contiguous block leaks across the split.

headkey_tailkey.format: flat printed Python list of clicked URLs; NOT linked to individual queries
headkey_tailkey.usability_finding: No per-query linkage present (flat URL list only). Cannot be used for per-query click-position, no-click, or session analysis.

schema_availability.finding: The raw AOL query log (AnonID, Query, QueryTime, ItemRank, ClickURL) is not present anywhere in this repository -- only already-derived pair files (newMedium.txt, out (1).txt/train/test, head150.txt, headkey.txt, tailkey.txt) exist. The original code (separator.py, vidit.jain@ada.iiit.ac.in) never reads AnonID or QueryTime even when the raw log was available, so no session/user/temporal information was ever computed by the original project either. This repository cannot support sessionization, first-click-position, reformulation, or abandonment analysis without re-acquiring the raw AOL log, which is deliberately NOT done here (see docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md, Privacy).
